title: Explicit algebraic quotient level maps and their K-flat invertibility
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal, and P a cochain complex of A-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For any chosen left adjoints L_n to the exact derived restrictions along A→A/I^(n+1) [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-quotient-diagram], define T(P)_n=P tensor_A A/I^(n+1), with quotient-homomorphism transitions. Define c_n:Res_n(L_n(Q(P)))→Q(T(P)_n) by restricting the adjoint transpose of the localized ordinary scalar-insertion unit, followed by the exact restriction factorization and tensor symmetry. This is a concrete map for every P, carrying the derived unit to localized ordinary insertion. If P is K-flat in the two-sided total-tensor sense [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso], c_n is invertible. Record its canonical isomorphism with this very underlying map. No boundedness or sheaf hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: The free module on the underlying set gives a functorial flat resolution in the same module universe: the counit sends the basis vector at x to x. Module categories have exact integer-indexed colimits. Scalar extension preserves K-flat quasi-isomorphisms by the stated source theorem. Apply the exact-right-adjoint K-flat representative criterion to extension and exact restriction along the nth quotient map, and to the supplied derived adjunction. Its transpose of the localized ordinary unit is invertible.

Restrict the scalar-extension tensor back to A. The identity additive equivalence is A-linear by tensor induction. Compose with tensor symmetry to identify the restricted extension with tensor on the right by the quotient module. Apply this natural comparison degreewise, then the exact scalar restriction factorization through localization. The resulting level map is defined on every complex, and is invertible on K-flat complexes. Applying the adjunction Hom bijection to its defining transpose cancels the exact factorization and yields precisely the localized scalar-insertion unit equation.

lean.statement:
def adicOrdinaryTensorLevelComparison
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (L : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} A) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1))))
    (adj : ∀ n : ℕ, L n ⊣ DerivedCategory.adicLevelRestriction I n)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} A) ℤ) (hP : P.IsKFlatForTotalTensor) (n : ℕ) :
    (DerivedCategory.adicLevelRestriction I n).obj ((L n).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((adicOrdinaryTensorComplexDiagram I P).obj (op n))
